final_message:
Yen receipts now show correctly: 500 JPY renders as `Paid ¥500 by card`. `npm test` passes, all 18 tests.

The cause was in `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divided every amount by 100, which is right for pounds but wrong for yen, since yen has no minor unit. I added a small set of zero-decimal currencies (just JPY for now) and format those amounts without the divide-by-100.

`formatMoney` is shared, so the same fix applies to invoices, cart and admin whenever they format yen.
